name: Ame ni Shite Hito o Hazure
source:
An otherworldly senpai. A suspicious series of murders.
A mysterious shark that appears on rainy days. 
A series of events that begin to engulf my surroundings.
How is this all connected?

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2168610/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一个超凡脱俗的前辈。一系列可疑的谋杀案。
雨天出现的神秘鲨鱼。
一系列事件开始席卷我的周围。
这一切是如何联系起来的？

[编辑自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2168610/]Steam[/url]]
